drafts.walkScript: At line 32 the dog leaves its fallen master and runs up to Jane. Line 32 says 'it was all he could do'. Lines 32 and 33 give the reason: there was 'no other help at hand to summon'. 'Summon' means call for, so Jane was the only person it could fetch. The barking on line 30 is something it did, not why it ran.

Lines 24 and 25 tell Mrs Otis 'blood has been spilt on that spot'. At line 26 her 'How horrid!' turns straight into a complaint about the room. She does not 'care for blood-stains in a sitting-room'. Line 27 says 'It must be removed at once.' She never asks whose blood it is, so the mark matters more than its story.

Line 33 says Maggie's 'power of sacrifice did not extend so far'. Line 33 then says she 'cared less' about Tom enjoying the biggest share. Lines 34 and 35 say she cared more that 'he should be pleased with her'. Line 35 goes on 'So she shut her eyes quite close'. She keeps her eyes shut to win Tom's good opinion, not to feed him.

At line 49 Ben offers only the core of his apple. Line 51 has Tom start to give way, then say 'No, Ben, now don't.' Straight after that no, line 52 has Ben offer 'all of it!' Each time Tom holds back, Ben wants a turn even more. Tom only gives up the brush at line 53, after the offer.
